title: Parking Lot Arrangement
body:
n cars are parked at distinct positions on a long street. In one move you pick up a car and park it at any empty position. Find the minimum number of moves so the cars occupy n consecutive positions.

Also seen as "Data Server Storage Consolidation" with servers instead of cars.

Function to complete

Complete minMoves(positions). It returns the minimum number of cars to move.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
cons: 1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10<sup>5</sup> in this mock (10<sup>7</sup> in one report: use fast input)

samples.ex: Keep 15, 18, 20 and move the other three into 16, 17, 19.

lc: 2009 Minimum Number of Operations to Make Array Continuous

py.pre:
from typing import *
import sys, math, collections, heapq, bisect, itertools, functools
from collections import *
py.post:
if __name__ == "__main__":
    _raw = sys.stdin.read(); _t = _raw.split(); _p = 0
    _n = int(_t[_p]); _p += 1
    positions = list(map(int, _t[_p:_p + (_n)])); _p += (_n)
    _r = Solution().minMoves(positions)
    print(_r)
